description: This file contains a helper class ApiTokenHelper used for generating JWT tokens for users with specific roles within integration tests for the Public API. It includes methods to create tokens for admin and normal users, constructing JWTs with claims for username and roles.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A helper class for generating JWT tokens for different user roles during integration testing.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an administrator user with 'Administrators' role.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no specific roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with the specified username and roles, including claims and signing credentials.
